mainEntity.name: Why does employment eligibility matter in a work visa matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: The practical point is that work and business routes depend on the real activity in Brazil, the structure around it, and documents that match the proposed purpose closely. In real cases, employment eligibility changes route fit, documents, and timing. No public explanation can replace a review of the actual file.
